svg.title: SVG Image created as BugBot_Vision_Board.svg date 2026-09-09T01:02:26

g.style: fill:#000000; fill-opacity:1.0000;stroke:#000000; stroke-opacity:1.0000; stroke-linecap:round; stroke-linejoin:round;

g.text: Stack: J8 = 3V3 + I2C (motor drivers, IMU) + MOT_INT + VBAT_SENSE + VMOT; J9 = odometry SPI + IMU_CS/INT + USB (D-/D+ to the Motion board's USB-C). The Motion board's S3 is gone: its next revision is a power-and-drive board.

g.desc: Stack: J8 = 3V3 + I2C (motor drivers, IMU) + MOT_INT + VBAT_SENSE + VMOT; J9 = odometry SPI + IMU_CS/INT + USB (D-/D+ to the Motion board's USB-C). The Motion board's S3 is gone: its next revision is a power-and-drive board.

g.text: The module is hand-soldered after JLCPCB assembly (not a stock part). Camera: OV5647 head on a 22-pin Pi Zero flex.

g.desc: The module is hand-soldered after JLCPCB assembly (not a stock part). Camera: OV5647 head on a 22-pin Pi Zero flex.

g.text: Top of the two-board stack: Waveshare ESP32-P4-Module (P4 + C6 WiFi6), MIPI camera, gimbal servos, 8x8 ToF. The robot's only processor.

g.desc: Top of the two-board stack: Waveshare ESP32-P4-Module (P4 + C6 WiFi6), MIPI camera, gimbal servos, 8x8 ToF. The robot's only processor.

g.text: Signal flow runs left to right. GND is global; 3V3, VMOT and the I2C bus are joined by name on short stubs. 3V3 arrives clean from the Motion board's converter: no regulator on this board.

g.desc: Signal flow runs left to right. GND is global; 3V3, VMOT and the I2C bus are joined by name on short stubs. 3V3 arrives clean from the Motion board's converter: no regulator on this board.
